verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented region or data-residency selection for LangGraph or its hosted Agent Server/LangSmith Deployment. Pluggable checkpointers (e.g. PostgresSaver) and local Docker stacks let developers run their own databases. That is a building block for self-hosting, not a residency control the product provides, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
